assertions: Her husband at sea is still alive, not dead or drowned
The husband is safe and well and unharmed, free from shipwreck, captivity and grave affliction
The husband will return home safely
The wife herself is gravely and chronically ill, relapsing from one disease into another, and her condition will worsen
The wife will die of her illness, timed to about 8 October following
She will not live to enjoy the reunion she asks for, dying before her husband's return can benefit her
reasoning: Husband's significator the Sun is in his hayz and free from all affliction, which in Lilly's horary rules shows the absent man alive, well and returning safely. For the querent herself, taken from the 7th house in this question, Saturn lord of the 6th retrograde shows chronic relapsing sickness; Mars and Saturn moving to an ill aspect, with Mars coming to the place of the Moon, afflict her significator/Moon and time her death, given in the figure as 8 October following.
summary: Her husband is alive, safe and will return, but she herself will die of her relapsing illness around 8 October following.
